cards.front: You pay Rp10,000 for something that costs Rp7,000. What is your change?
cards.say: You pay ten thousand rupiah for something that costs seven thousand rupiah. What is your change? Three thousand rupiah. Ten thousand take away seven thousand is three thousand.

cards.front: You pay Rp5,000 for something that costs Rp3,500. What is your change?
cards.say: You pay five thousand rupiah for something that costs three thousand five hundred rupiah. What is your change? One thousand five hundred rupiah

cards.front: You pay Rp20,000 for something that costs Rp12,000. What is your change?

cards.front: You pay Rp50,000 for something that costs Rp30,000. What is your change?
cards.say: You pay fifty thousand rupiah for something that costs thirty thousand rupiah. What is your change? Twenty thousand rupiah

cards.front: A pen costs Rp3,000 and a ruler costs Rp2,000. What is the total?

cards.front: An eraser costs Rp2,000. How much do 3 erasers cost?
cards.say: An eraser costs two thousand rupiah. How much do three erasers cost? Six thousand rupiah. Three times two thousand equals six thousand.

cards.front: A notebook costs Rp5,000. How much do 4 notebooks cost?
cards.say: A notebook costs five thousand rupiah. How much do four notebooks cost? Twenty thousand rupiah

cards.front: A sweet costs Rp500. How much do 5 sweets cost?
cards.say: A sweet costs five hundred rupiah. How much do five sweets cost? Two thousand five hundred rupiah

cards.front: A pencil costs Rp1,500. How much do 2 pencils cost?

cards.front: How many Rp10,000 notes make Rp50,000?

cards.front: How many Rp20,000 notes make Rp100,000?
cards.say: How many twenty thousand rupiah notes make one hundred thousand rupiah? Five notes

cards.front: Rp12,000 is shared equally among 4 children. How much does each child get?
cards.say: Twelve thousand rupiah is shared equally among four children. How much does each child get? Three thousand rupiah. Twelve divided by four equals three, so twelve thousand divided by four equals three thousand.

cards.front: Which note is worth more: Rp20,000 or Rp5,000?
cards.say: Which note is worth more: twenty thousand rupiah or five thousand rupiah? Twenty thousand rupiah
